text: NovaTech Solutions is a fictional software company founded in 2023. Its headquarters is in Noida, India.
NovaTech Solutions has three departments: Artificial Intelligence, Data Engineering, and Cloud Infrastructure.
NovaTech Solutions launched its internal AI assistant called NovaMind in February 2026.
NovaMind is designed to answer employee questions about company policies, projects, internal documentation, and technical procedures.
The NovaMind project was led by Priya Mehta, who is the fictional Head of Artificial Intelligence at NovaTech Solutions.
NovaTech Solutions uses a fictional internal knowledge platform called AtlasHub to store engineering documentation.
AtlasHub contains documentation for APIs, deployment procedures, incident response processes, and internal coding standards.
NovaTech Solutions has a fictional employee training program called AI Launchpad. The program lasts six weeks and covers Python, embeddings, vector databases, RAG, and AI agents.
Employees who complete AI Launchpad receive a fictional internal certification called Nova AI Engineer Level 1.
The fictional NovaTech engineering team holds its weekly technical review meeting every Friday at 4 PM.
